capabilities: Run Rant programs in rant code blocks and show the rendered result in preview
Insert inline Rant programs via rant: inline code blocks
Embed Rant blocks from other notes using block links and import statements
Apply Markdown formatting through added bold, italic, highlight, and link functions
Re-run all Rant blocks in a file with a new random seed via a command
extras: Can also be installed via BRAT as a beta plugin; output varies on each run because Rant picks random block elements, so inline embeds and re-runs are nondeterministic.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run procedural text-generation templates like Rant inside notes and render their random results.

relations.evidence: Thin wrapper around the Rant language Rust crate to be used in Obsidian.
Example using the dice-roller plugin within a Rant block

summary: Code-block integration for the Rant procedural templating language that runs generative text programs and renders their output in preview.
